faqs.question: What are the FBR income tax slabs for 2025-26 in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: For tax year 2025-26, annual income up to PKR 600,000 is exempt. Above that, marginal rates progress from 5% (PKR 600,001–1,200,000) to 35% (above PKR 4,100,000). Salaried persons and AOP/business persons use different schedules.

/zakat-info.h1: Zakat Rules in Pakistan — A Plain-Language Guide
/zakat-info.intro: Zakat is one of the five pillars of Islam. In Pakistan, the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) announces the annual Nisab threshold based on the value of gold or silver. This page explains the rules, who pays, and what counts toward Zakat.

faqs.question: What is the SBP Zakat Nisab for 2026 in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: The SBP announces the Zakat Nisab each year based on the value of 612.36 grams of silver (and 87.48 grams of gold). For tax year 2026, the silver Nisab threshold is the basis banks use to determine automatic 2.5% Zakat deduction from savings accounts on 1st Ramadan.

/income-tax.description: Calculate your FBR income tax for Tax Year 2026 (Historical). Enter your monthly salary to calculate annual tax, monthly deductions, and your exact tax bracket.
/income-tax.intro: Understanding your income tax liability in Pakistan can be complicated. Our calculator uses the official Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) tax slabs for Tax Year 2026 (Finance Act 2025). This is a historical/reference calculator as the current tax year is TY 2027.

faqs.question: What is the income tax rate in Pakistan 2025-26?
faqs.answer: For salaried persons under Finance Act 2025, annual income up to PKR 600,000 is tax-free. Above that, the marginal rates are 1% (PKR 600,001–1,200,000), 11% (PKR 1,200,001–2,200,000), 23% (PKR 2,200,001–3,200,000), 30% (PKR 3,200,001–4,100,000), and 35% above PKR 4,100,000. A 10% surcharge is added to the slab tax if annual taxable income exceeds PKR 10,000,000.

faqs.question: How much salary is tax free in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Monthly salary up to PKR 50,000 (annual PKR 600,000) is completely tax-free in Pakistan for salaried employees under FBR Tax Year 2025-26.

faqs.question: How to calculate income tax on salary in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Multiply your monthly salary by 12 to get your annual taxable income, subtract any allowable exemptions (such as the medical-allowance exemption), then apply the FBR slab rates to each band above PKR 600,000. Our calculator does this step-by-step and shows every band.

faqs.question: Is there a 10% surcharge on income tax above PKR 10 million?
faqs.answer: Yes. Finance Act 2025 introduced a 10% surcharge on the computed slab tax for individuals and AOPs whose annual taxable income exceeds PKR 10,000,000. The surcharge is 10% of the slab tax (not 10% of income). It does not apply to companies.

faqs.question: Is freelancer income taxable in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Freelancers earning above PKR 600,000 annually must file returns with FBR via IRIS. IT export income registered with PSEB is taxed at a reduced rate (currently 0.25%) under separate provisions; talk to a tax practitioner about Section 236C remittance credits.

faqs.question: Do non-salaried and business income use different slabs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Non-salaried individuals, AOPs and businesses follow a separate, steeper schedule under Finance Act 2025. Our calculator switches to that schedule when you pick Non-Salaried / AOP.

faqs.question: What is the deadline to file my income tax return?
faqs.answer: For Tax Year 2025-26, the return-filing deadline is 30 September 2026 for salaried persons. AOPs and businesses typically file by 31 December. Late filing attracts penalties under section 182 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.

/zakat.title: Zakat Calculator Pakistan 2026 — SBP Nisab Rs 503,529 (Official)
/zakat.description: Calculate Zakat on savings, gold, silver & business assets. Uses official Government Nisab Rs 503,529 (SBP 2026). Toggle between bank auto-deduction and Islamic (silver/gold) Nisab. Free.
/zakat.intro: Calculate your Zakat using the official Government-notified Nisab of Rs 503,529 (SBP BPRD Circular 03 of 2026, Ministry of Poverty Alleviation Notification CE-1001(36)/NISAB/1446-47/2026-48). Or switch to the Hanafi silver/gold standard for your personal calculation.

faqs.question: What is the SBP-notified Zakat Nisab in Pakistan for 2026?
faqs.answer: The Administrator General Zakat fixed the Nisab for Zakat Year 1446-47 AH at Rs 503,529. This is the threshold banks use on 1st Ramadan (19–20 February 2026, subject to moon sighting) to auto-deduct 2.5% Zakat from savings, PLS and similar accounts.

faqs.question: How to calculate Zakat in Pakistan 2026?
faqs.answer: Add all Zakatable assets (cash, gold, silver, business inventory at market value, receivables). Subtract short-term debts due within 12 months. If net wealth equals or exceeds Nisab and has been held for a full lunar year (Hawl ≈ 354 days), Zakat = 2.5% of net wealth.

faqs.question: How much Zakat is deducted from bank accounts in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Banks in Pakistan deduct Zakat at 2.5% on the first day of Ramadan from savings, PLS and similar accounts whose balance equals or exceeds the notified Nisab (Rs 503,529 for 2026). The deducted amount is deposited into Central Zakat Account No. CZ-08 with the State Bank of Pakistan.

faqs.question: How do I stop my bank from deducting Zakat?
faqs.answer: Submit a CZ-50 declaration to your bank before 1st Ramadan. This is a legally-binding statement under the Zakat & Ushr Ordinance, 1980 that you will pay Zakat yourself. After submission, the bank will not deduct Zakat at source that year.

faqs.question: Is Zakat payable on a house I live in?
faqs.answer: No. A house you occupy for personal use is not Zakatable. Real estate becomes Zakatable only when it is held for trade or resale (e.g., a property dealer's stock). Personal-use property, primary residence, and personal-use vehicles are excluded.

faqs.question: What is Hawl in Zakat?
faqs.answer: Hawl is the full Islamic lunar year (≈ 354 days) during which your wealth must remain at or above Nisab for Zakat to become obligatory. If your wealth drops below Nisab during the year and does not recover before Hawl completes, the year restarts once it returns above Nisab.

faqs.question: Which Nisab should I use — Government or silver/gold?
faqs.answer: Use the Government Nisab (Rs 503,529) if you want to mirror what your bank deducts on 1st Ramadan. Many Hanafi scholars prefer the lower of gold-nisab or silver-nisab at live sarafa rates for personal Zakat payment — this captures more people as Zakat-eligible. Our calculator supports both.

howTo.name: How to Calculate Zakat Accurately in Pakistan (2.5% Formula)
howTo.description: Steps to evaluate your net worth and determine your Zakat obligation using SBP-notified and Islamic Nisab values.

steps.name: Choose your Nisab
steps.text: Pick the Government Nisab (Rs 503,529) for bank parity, or the Islamic silver/gold standard for personal calculation.

steps.name: Tally your assets
steps.text: Add cash in hand, bank balances, current-market-value gold and silver, business inventory, and receivables likely to be collected.

steps.name: Deduct short-term liabilities
steps.text: Subtract debts due within 12 months — utility bills, short-term loans, unpaid Zakat from prior years. Do not deduct long-term mortgage principal.

steps.name: Compare with Nisab + Hawl
steps.text: If your net wealth is at or above Nisab and has been held for a full lunar year (Hawl ≈ 354 days), Zakat is obligatory.

steps.name: Calculate 2.5%
steps.text: Pay 2.5% of net wealth directly to eligible recipients, or rely on your bank's auto-deduction on 1st Ramadan (after submitting a CZ-50 exemption if you want to opt out).

faqs.question: Is there tax on freelancers in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes, freelancer income is taxable under FBR rules. However, under Section 154A, IT and IT-enabled services export income enjoys a concessionary 0.25% tax rate if the freelancer is registered with PSEB, is on the Active Taxpayer List (ATL), files returns, and brings at least 80% of export proceeds to Pakistan. Otherwise, a 1% rate or normal taxation applies.

faqs.question: How much do freelancers earn per month in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Freelancer income varies widely. Pakistani IT freelancers typically earn between PKR 50,000 to PKR 500,000+ per month depending on skills. After bank charges, platform fees, and taxes, your net take-home will be reduced.

faqs.question: Do I get taxed on Upwork and Fiverr in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes, when your Upwork or Fiverr earnings are remitted to your Pakistani bank account, the bank is legally required to deduct withholding tax upon realization. This is 0.25% if you meet all Section 154A conditions (including PSEB registration and ATL status), or 1% if you do not.

faqs.question: How can a freelancer become a filer in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: You can become a filer by registering on FBR's IRIS portal, obtaining a National Tax Number (NTN), and filing your annual income tax return declaring your foreign remittance income.

faqs.question: What is the latest KIBOR rate in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: KIBOR (Karachi Interbank Offered Rate) fluctuates daily based on SBP monetary policy. Banks usually charge KIBOR + a spread of 2-5%. Check our tool for estimated monthly payments.

faqs.question: How much is the car loan down payment?
faqs.answer: In Pakistan, down payments usually range from 15% to 30% of the car's total value, strictly dictated by SBP regulations and the individual bank's policy.

faqs.question: Can I pay off my auto loan early in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes, but be prepared. Most commercial banks charge an 'early settlement penalty,' which is typically 2% to 5% of the remaining unpaid principal.

faqs.question: Why does my monthly installment keep increasing?
faqs.answer: If your loan uses a variable markup tied to KIBOR, your EMI will readjust annually or bi-annually. When KIBOR spikes, your bank raises your monthly installment accordingly.

/provident-fund.description: Calculate your monthly PF deduction and employer contribution instantly. Enter basic salary → get exact amounts. Updated for Pakistan 2026.

faqs.question: What is PF contribution calculation formula in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: PF contribution = 10% of basic salary (employee) + 10% of basic salary (employer). Total monthly deposit = 20% of basic salary into the PF trust.

faqs.question: How to calculate provident fund in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Multiply your basic salary by 10% to get your monthly PF deduction. Your employer adds an equal amount. Both go into your PF account every month.

faqs.question: Is PF deducted on gross salary or basic salary?
faqs.answer: In Pakistan, your Provident Fund is always deducted from your basic salary portion, never the gross salary. Allowances like travel, medical, and housing are completely excluded from the PF calculation.

faqs.question: Can I withdraw my Provident Fund before retirement?
faqs.answer: Yes, most recognized provident funds allow partial withdrawals or loans against your balance for specific emergencies, such as purchasing/constructing a house, major medical illnesses, or children's higher education. However, rules vary per organization's Trust Deed.

faqs.question: Is my Provident Fund balance taxable in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: If your company operates a Recognized Provident Fund (registered with the FBR/Commissioner of Inland Revenue), the lump sum payout you receive at retirement or resignation is generally 100% tax-free. Unrecognized funds may incur tax on the employer's portion and accrued interest.

faqs.question: What happens to my PF if I change jobs?
faqs.answer: When you resign, you are entitled to receive your entire accumulated balance, including both your contributions, the employer's matching contributions, and accrued interest, provided you have completed the minimum vesting period laid out by your HR policy (often 1-3 years).

faqs.question: What is gratuity law in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Under Pakistan Labour Law, every permanent employee is entitled to gratuity after completing 1 year of continuous service. The formula is: Last drawn salary ÷ 26 × 30 × years served. The Standing Orders Ordinance 1968 defines 'wages' as gross salary, though many employers apply basic salary.

faqs.question: What is gratuity formula in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Gratuity = (Last drawn salary ÷ 26) × 30 × Number of years served. The /26 × 30 multiplier is the standard idiom for monthly wage expressed in calendar days.

faqs.question: Is gratuity taxable in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Gratuity received from an approved gratuity fund is exempt from tax up to PKR 300,000. Any amount above PKR 300,000 is taxable under FBR rules.

faqs.question: What if employer does not pay gratuity?
faqs.answer: Employees can file a complaint with the Labour Court or NIRC (National Industrial Relations Commission) for non-payment of gratuity in Pakistan.

faqs.question: How to calculate investment profit in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Investment profit is calculated by subtracting the initial cost from the final maturity value. Use our calculator to see how your wealth grows over time with factors like annual compounding rates.

faqs.question: What is a good ROI for property in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: A good rental yield in major Pakistani cities like Karachi or Lahore is typically 4-6% annually, while residential capital appreciation can range from 10% to 20% in developing sectors.

faqs.question: How does inflation affect my ROI in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Pakistan experiences high inflation (historically 8-15%). If your bank savings return is 12% but inflation is 15%, your real ROI is mechanically negative. You must seek returns higher than the inflation rate to accumulate actual purchasing power.

faqs.question: Are mutual funds a safe investment in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Mutual funds managed by SECP-regulated Asset Management Companies are relatively safe and highly transparent. Money market funds offer stable, low-risk ROI, while equity funds carry higher risk with potentially higher returns.

faqs.question: How much pension will I get in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Pension amounts depend on your service years and last drawn salary for government workers. For private sector workers, building a substantial separate fund in Voluntary Pension Schemes (VPS) or Mutual Funds is essential.

faqs.question: Is VPS better than Gratuity?
faqs.answer: VPS is an investment-linked saving plan that offers tax credits and growth, while Gratuity is a lump-sum end-of-service statutory benefit provided by your employer. Both are vital for retirement.

faqs.question: How large should my retirement corpus be in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: With PKR devaluation, experts suggest accumulating 25 to 30 times your estimated annual retirement expenses to sustain your lifestyle safely through withdrawal.

faqs.question: Can I rely solely on EOBI for retirement?
faqs.answer: EOBI provides a very basic minimum pension (currently PKR 10,000/month). Relying solely on EOBI will make it extremely difficult to cover ordinary living costs, let alone medical healthcare.

faqs.question: What are FBR property transfer taxes in 2026?
faqs.answer: For 2025-26, FBR transfer taxes for filers are approximately 3% and significantly higher for non-filers (up to 12% or more). Always check latest FBR active tax payer list (ATL) status.

faqs.question: How is rental yield calculated in Karachi?
faqs.answer: Rental Yield = (Monthly Rent × 12) / Total Property Value. In Karachi, average residential yields are 3-5%, while commercial shops can go higher.

faqs.question: Is it better to invest in plots or built houses in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Plots generally offer greater long-term capital appreciation with minimal maintenance, whereas built houses provide immediate monthly rental yield cash flow but require upkeep.

faqs.question: What is Capital Gains Tax (CGT) on property in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: CGT is a tax levied by FBR on the profit made when selling land. The rate decreases the longer you hold the property. Selling within year one incurs a flat 15%, while holding for 6+ years brings it down to 0%.

faqs.question: How to calculate profit margin for a business in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Profit Margin = (Revenue - Cost) / Revenue × 100. If you buy a product for PKR 800 and sell it for PKR 1,000, your profit margin is 20%.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Margin and Markup?
faqs.answer: Margin is your profit shown as a percentage of your final selling price. Markup is your profit depicted as a percentage of your cost. (e.g. 20% margin = 25% markup).

faqs.question: What is a good profit margin for retail in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: In Pakistan, competitive retail margins range from 10% to 30% depending on the sector. Daraz sellers must account for platform fees and packaging before determining true net margins.

faqs.question: How many Kanal in 1 Murabba in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: 1 Murabba = 25 Acres = 200 Kanal in Pakistan. A Murabba is commonly used for agricultural land measurement in Punjab. 200 Murabba would be 40,000 Kanal.

faqs.question: How to calculate percentage in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Divide the part by the whole and multiply by 100. For example, if you got 45 marks out of 50, your percentage is (45/50) * 100 = 90%.

faqs.question: How to calculate electricity bill in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: To calculate your bill of electricity in Pakistan, use the WAPDA unit calculator. Simply enter your consumed units. The tool evaluates the electricity bill calculation formula in Pakistan by applying the appropriate NEPRA slab, adding the Fuel Price Adjustment (FPA), 18% GST, and other surcharges.

faqs.question: What is the WAPDA unit price in Pakistan for commercial and residential?
faqs.answer: WAPDA per unit price varies. For residential protected consumers, it starts very low (Rs. 10.54/unit). Non-protected residential starts at Rs. 22.44/unit. WAPDA commercial unit price is typically much higher and mostly a flat rate ranging from Rs. 39 to Rs. 50+ per unit depending on the exact load and tariff category (like A-2).

faqs.question: 1 WAPDA unit kitne kW hota hai?
faqs.answer: 1 WAPDA unit = 1 kilowatt-hour (kWh). Matlab ek 1000 watt ka appliance 1 ghante mein 1 unit bijli consume karta hai. Agar aapka appliance 500 watt ka hai, to woh 2 ghante mein 1 unit use karega.

faqs.question: 300 watt ka appliance 8 ghante mein kitni units use karta hai?
faqs.answer: 300W × 8 hours = 2,400 Wh = 2.4 units per day. Monthly (30 days) = 72 units. Formula: (Watts × Hours × Days) ÷ 1000 = Units.

faqs.question: Pakistan mein 100 units ka bill kitna aata hai?
faqs.answer: NEPRA protected category (1-100 units) mein 100 units ka bill approximately PKR 1,957 aata hai. Non-protected mein Rs. 19.57/unit se shuru hota hai. Taxes (GST 18%, FPA, surcharges) add hone ke baad final bill Rs. 2,400 ke qareeb ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: LESCO aur FESCO ka rate same hota hai?
faqs.answer: NEPRA tariff mostly uniform hai lekin fuel adjustment charges (FPA) alag ho sakti hain har DISCO ke liye. Basic unit rate same NEPRA schedule follow karta hai. LESCO (Lahore) aur FESCO (Faisalabad) dono ka base rate same hai, sirf monthly FPA mein farq ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: How to calculate BMI in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: BMI = Weight (kg) / Height (m²). For example, if you weigh 70kg and are 1.75m tall, your BMI = 70 / (1.75 × 1.75) = 22.86 (Normal weight). BMI categories: Under 18.5 = Underweight, 18.5-24.9 = Normal, 25-29.9 = Overweight, 30+ = Obese.

faqs.question: How to calculate GPA in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: In Pakistan, GPA is calculated by: 1) Multiplying each course's grade points by its credit hours, 2) Adding all quality points, 3) Dividing by total credit hours. HEC uses 4.0 scale where A = 4.0, B+ = 3.3, B = 3.0, etc.

faqs.question: How is Matric grade calculated in BISE Lahore?
faqs.answer: In Pakistan's Matric system: A1 (Outstanding) = 80%+, A (Excellent) = 70-79%, B (Very Good) = 60-69%. Our tool automates this for all boards including Punjab, Sindh, KPK, and Balochistan.

faqs.answer: 900 ÷ 1100 × 100 = 81.81%. Yeh A grade mein aata hai Pakistan ke Matric board system mein.
